messages:
CobaltPM: @mia_cs hi — we're ready to start onboarding a forecasting model for Cobalt Energy. Need private-hosted deployment (EU-only), backtesting on ~3 years of hourly meter data, and a safety review because model outputs will be used for operator guidance (no direct actuation). Model is a finetuned open-weights variant: cobalt-forecast-13b v1.2. Can you advise next steps and what data access you need?

mia_cs: :wave: thanks! We'll own intake. Quick Qs: 1) target timeline for POC? 2) rough data size and format? 3) any regulatory/compliance notes we should flag? I'll loop in Raj and Linus.

raj_se: looped in. Hi — from Solutions Eng, we'll need a sample dataset (S3 path or secure transfer), schema, and expected query patterns (batch vs realtime). Also confirm whether you need Dedicated capacity or Hosted with private networking. We'll also check pricing impact for sustained hourly workloads.

linus_ml: for ML/evals: does backtesting include edge cases like outage/black-sky scenarios? Any requirements for explainability (SHAP/feature attribution logs)? Also is quantization acceptable for perf (we can test q4_0 / int8 variants). If EU-only, do you need KMS integration for keys?

CobaltPM: Target POC end of Q3. Data is ~10M hourly rows (~50GB compressed), Parquet with timestamps and labels available. No direct control commands allowed in outputs. EU data residency required. Prefer hosted private (Redwood Private) in eu-west-1 rather than on-prem to start. Can share S3 creds via secure intake.

mia_cs: solid — I'll spin up an intake ticket and schedule an onboarding call. Tentative flow: security checklist -> data transfer -> perf + safety eval -> pilot. @raj_se can you pick a slot for next week? @linus_ml can you create a short eval template (perf + safety tests)?

raj_se: i'm available Wed 10:00 CET or Thu 15:00 CET. Prefer Wed 10 if that works.

CobaltPM: Wed 10:00 CET works for our PM and infra contact.

mia_cs: booked Wed 10 CET — invite sent. attaching privacy/compliance checklist in the calendar. Next actions for the call: bring data sample access, infra contact, desired request qps and latency SLOs (99p).

linus_ml: prepping an eval template. Example model/deployment spec I'll bring to the call:

```yaml
model: cobalt-forecast-13b
version: v1.2
deployment: private-hosted
region: eu-west-1
sla_latency_99p_ms: 250
data_path: s3://cobalt-energy/poc/2025/
backtest_window: 36 months
safety_constraints:
  - no-actuation
  - pii_strip: true
```

mia_cs: created intake ticket CS-4821 and linked this thread. deploy-bot: CS-4821 created by mia_cs (priority: P2).

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4821 created: "Cobalt Energy — forecasting model onboarding" assigned to mia_cs, raj_se, linus_ml.

CobaltPM: perfect thanks everyone — we'll prepare the sample dataset and infra contact details before Wed. Appreciate the quick response.

mia_cs: thanks! i'll follow up with the prep checklist and upload SSO instructions for the shared S3 bucket.

raj_se: i'll draft an estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted-private cost so you have numbers for the call.

linus_ml: bringing perf harness and safety test checklist — we'll aim to run an initial perf sweep in eu-west-1 after we get the sample.

CobaltPM: noted. See you Wed.
